metadata.description: Claude Code distribution of the Infiquetra portable Agent Plugins catalog. Each entry installs a portable package together with its Claude client extension; the packages themselves stay vendor-neutral.

plugins.name: agent-launcher
plugins.description: Create one verified coding-agent session through the agents wrapper and Herdr. Orchestrate consumes this shared launch surface.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Guarded synchronous Codex delegation for Claude Code. The delegate command and the coder and reviewer agents all route through the portable wrapper.

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: tag-promotion deployment operations for Infiquetra repositories.

plugins.name: hermes-profile-evolution
plugins.description: Claude Code request surface for target-sovereign Hermes profile evolution.

plugins.name: home-lab-ops
plugins.description: Proxmox VE cluster operations, Ansible pre-flight validation, Ceph management, monitoring guard, and vault helper for home lab infrastructure

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Output style enforcing Infiquetra's house presentation rules for Claude Code turns and subagent relays.

plugins.name: redis-channel
plugins.description: Claude Code channel that bridges sessions to external systems over Redis Streams. Router-agnostic: pair with any router implementation that speaks the protocol.

plugins.name: unifi
plugins.description: UniFi Network and Protect CLI for managing UDM devices, clients, VLANs, firewall rules, traffic routes, DNS, cameras, liveviews, lights, sensors, chimes, and viewers

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: A spoken conversational loop and Auralis bridge adapter for one explicitly bound, Herdr-managed Claude Code session: the bound session receives voice context, submits authored spoken renderings, and speaks completed responses.
